wizard
  views <guid>                                       Checkout a view for editing
  views new <entity> --name "<name>"                  Scaffold a new view

main form

form for editing

Quick Create form

Create form for editing
  sitemap <appmodule-name>                           Checkout a sitemap for 
editing
  entity <logical-name>                              Checkout entity metadata 
for editing
  entity new <schema> --display-name "<name>"       Create a new custom entity
  entity attribute add <entity> <name> --type <t>     Add a new field (lookup, 
string, int, ...)
  icon new <webresource> <svg> [--entity <e>]         Stage a new icon upload
  icon set <entity> <webresource>                     Set entity icon to 
existing resource
